pages.name: Care and Feeding For Your Faction

text.content:
Measuring the Health of Your Faction

A faction is more than the territory it controls or the resources it spends.

It is a living organization made up of people, beliefs, and relationships. As the campaign unfolds, the condition of that organization changes.

Faction Tracks represent the overall health and stability of your faction.

They show how well the organization is functioning and how the world responds to your actions.

These tracks shift over time as the faction succeeds, struggles, or faces difficult decisions.

Why Faction Tracks Matter

Faction Tracks help tell the story of your organization.

They answer questions like:

• Do people still believe in the faction’s mission?
• Are communities inspired or discouraged by your actions?
• Is the faction becoming stronger or more unstable?

Because of this, faction tracks are constantly influenced by the choices players make during the campaign.

A single decision may seem small in the moment, but over time those decisions shape the overall condition of the faction.

The Core Tracks

Most factions monitor several key measures that reflect their condition.

These tracks represent different aspects of the faction’s strength.

Morale

Morale represents the emotional energy of the faction.

When morale is high, people feel hopeful and motivated. Members of the faction believe their work matters and are willing to take risks to achieve their goals.

When morale falls, Stress and doubt begin to spread. Members may lose confidence in the mission or become hesitant to act.

Morale is influenced by victories, defeats, and the overall progress of the faction’s efforts.

Loyalty

Loyalty reflects how strongly people trust the faction’s leadership and direction.

High loyalty means that members and communities believe the faction is acting in their best interests.

Low loyalty suggests growing distrust, disagreement, or internal conflict.

Loyalty can shift when factions make difficult decisions that affect the communities they serve.

Unity

Unity represents how well the different parts of the faction work together.

A unified faction coordinates effectively, resolves disagreements, and moves toward common goals.

Low unity indicates fragmentation within the organization. Rival groups, competing priorities, or ideological divisions may begin to appear.

Maintaining unity becomes more challenging as factions grow larger and more complex.

Victory

Victory reflects the faction’s overall success in achieving its long-term goals.

Every successful expedition, stabilized hex, or defeated threat contributes to this measure.

Victory is not only about winning battles. It represents meaningful progress toward the Great Work.

As victory increases, the faction’s influence and reputation grow.

Darkness

Darkness measures the level of corruption or instability affecting the faction.

This does not always mean the faction has become malicious. Instead, it reflects the pressure of operating within a fractured world.

Darkness may increase when factions make harsh decisions, neglect communities, or allow corruption to spread.

Left unchecked, Darkness can weaken the organization and distort its original mission.

How Tracks Change

Faction Tracks move up or down based on what happens during the campaign.

They may change when:

• the faction succeeds or fails in major objectives
• communities are helped or harmed
• difficult moral choices are made
• corruption spreads or is contained

Because of this, faction tracks become a record of the story your group is creating together.

Balancing the Tracks

Healthy factions usually maintain balance across their tracks.

A faction with high victory but low morale may succeed in the short term but struggle to sustain its mission.

A faction with strong unity but growing darkness may face difficult ethical questions about its methods.

Players often need to decide which goals matter most in a given moment.

These decisions shape both the faction and the world around it.

Tracks and the Great Work

Faction Tracks also reflect how effectively your organization contributes to the restoration of the world.

A stable and unified faction is better able to:

• rebuild communities
• stabilize dangerous regions
• push back against corruption

In this way, the condition of your faction directly influences how much progress can be made toward the Great Work.

What Players Should Remember

Three simple ideas explain faction tracks.

1 — Tracks show how your faction is doing

They measure the health and stability of the organization.

2 — Tracks respond to your decisions

Every major action can influence one or more tracks.

3 — Tracks shape the campaign

The condition of your faction affects how the story unfolds.

In Simple Terms

Faction Tracks are the health indicators of your organization.

They reflect morale, trust, unity, success, and corruption within the faction.

As your group explores the world and makes decisions, these tracks change — recording the story of the faction’s rise, struggles, and impact on the world.
